assumptions: The controls are the same biological sample in every batch, so every difference between them is batch effect.
Each metacluster holds the same cell type in every batch; a batch with 50 cells or fewer in a metacluster is left as it is there.
limits: The normalized files are written to the project from the panel only; this door returns the model summary and the medians.
Linear float data ($PnE 0,0), as mass and spectral cytometers write; log-amplified files are refused.
bio.jane/contract.question: How must each batch be moved so that its control sample matches the others, and what does that do to the samples of that batch?

description: CytoNorm batch normalization learned from controls (a reference sample run in every batch): the controls' cells, on arcsinh(x / cofactor), build a FlowSOM map grouped into metaclusters; in each metacluster each batch's control quantiles are mapped onto a goal (the mean of the batches, or one batch) by a monotone Fritsch-Carlson spline, and every file of that batch is moved by its batch's spline in each cell's metacluster, then taken back by sinh.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

arcsinh_cofactor.description: the arcsinh cofactor (5 for mass cytometry).

batch_column.description: the sample sheet's column naming each file's batch.

channels.description: the channels to normalize, comma-separated PnN; empty for every channel but scatter, time and event length.

goal.description: 'mean' for the mean of the batches, or one batch label.

n_cells.description: nCells: control events the map is built on, an equal share per file.

n_metaclusters.description: FlowSOM nClus: the cell groups normalized separately.

n_quantiles.description: nQ: quantiles at i / (nQ + 1) per spline.

role_column.description: the sample sheet's column whose value is control (trains), sample (is normalized) or both.

sample_sheet.description: a CSV in the project whose first column, headed sample, names each FCS file, with a batch column and a role column.

samples.description: the FCS files, by name or id, comma-separated; empty for every FCS file in the project (each must be named in the sample sheet).

name: normalize_flow_cytometry_cytonorm

medians.description: per channel and normalized file, the median before and after (linear units)

metaclusters.description: per metacluster, the control cells per batch and the batches left as they are, with the reason
